run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a function over 100 iterations and print average ms
test_time_func_warmup: test time_func warmup phase that runs 5 iterations before measuring performance
create_benchmark_with_time_func: create a benchmark using time_func with a custom number of iterations
refactor_time_func_output: refactor time_func to return the measured time instead of printing it
summarize_time_func_usage: summarize time_func which measures average execution time of a callable in milliseconds
